# Dentist visit notes

## Cleaning 2025-02-18
Dr. Farah Siddiqui at Queen West Dental (the one above the bike shop at Queen and Gladstone). Hygienist Lorraine, who is lovely and also brutally honest. 4 bitewing X-rays. Gums fine, a bit of bleeding at the lower front. She noticed wear facets on my molars and asked if I grind. Probably, during nights after a bad shift.

## The cracked tooth
Lower right first molar, tooth 46, has a vertical crack line. Not painful yet, sometimes a zing on cold water. Dr. Siddiqui says crown now before it splits. Quote ref QWD-58123:

- porcelain crown on 46: $1,450
- core buildup: $265
- total $1,715

Crown done in two visits: prep 2025-03-25, seat 2025-04-08. Temporary came off once eating a Clif bar, glued back at no charge.

## Nightguard
Upper hard acrylic guard for clenching, $520. Sun Life plan through work pays 50% on "major" so I pay $260. Wearing it most nights, Dev says I sound like I'm chewing in my sleep without it. Links to the stress/shift stuff in [[Sleep]].

## Insurance math
- cleanings 100%, up to 2 per year
- crown 50% after the $50 deductible, annual max $1,500
- so for 2025: insurer paid $832.50 on the crown, I paid $882.50
More detail on the plan in [[Health insurance deductible]], and the dental line item in [[Budget spreadsheet]] went from $300 to $1,200 for the year, ouch.
